item.title: Transition VC Announces Final Close of Debut Fund at ₹700 crore
item.description: Transition VC has announced the final close of its debut fund at ₹700 crore (approximately USD 77 million), substantially overshooting its initial target of ₹400 crore. It is positioned as India’s first energy-transition focused venture capital fund, founded by Raiyaan Shingati and Mohammed Shoeb Ali. item.title: Naxion Energy Claims To Launch India’s First Sodium-Ion ESS
item.description: Naxion Energy has launched what it says is India’s first sodium-ion energy storage systems, aiming to offer a fully local and safer alternative to lead-acid batteries for residential, commercial and industrial use. The systems, designed and manufactured at the company’s Coimbatore facility, integrate a battery, inverter and solar MPPT in a single unit. item.title: Pralhad Joshi Launches Hydrogen Mobility Pilot with Toyota Mirai FCEV Handover
item.description: Union Minister for New & Renewable Energy (MNRE), Pralhad Joshi, launched the Pilot Project for field trails on the Use of Hydrogen in the Mobility Sector, describing it as a major milestone in India's clean energy advancements. The launch featured the handover of Toyota's Mirai hydrogen fuel cell electric vehicle (FCEV) to the National Institute of Solar Energy (NISE) for real-world testing. item.description: GVFL, one of India’s pioneering venture capital firms, has led a $12 Million funding round in Ahmedabad based Soleos Solar Energy, a rapidly growing renewable energy solutions and EPC service provider with a presence across India, Africa, and Europe. item.title: Renewables Gain Momentum in Indian Textile Industry, Yet Challenges Persist: ICRA
item.description: A new report from ICRA ESG Ratings Limited shows a steady increase in renewable energy adoption by Indian textile companies, even as energy use per unit of revenue has risen. The findings are based on a review of 19 major textile firms, including Page Industries Ltd, Welspun Living Ltd, Arvind Ltd, and KPR Mill Ltd, from FY2023 to FY2025. item.title: Waaree Energies Expands Manufacturing Capacity with Additional 1.5 GW at Samakhiali Facility
item.description: Indian solar module and cell manufactuter Waaree Energies has expanded its domestic production capacity by adding 1.5 GW of solar module manufacturing at its Samakhiali plant in Kutch, Gujarat. The expansion follows the commissioning of two high-efficiency module lines of 750 MW each at the same site, taking total new capacity added to 1.5 GW.
